messages:
liz: Morning — nightly NetSuite batch failed for ~34 invoices. Error looks like invalid tax code mapping from Stripe metadata.

liz: Log snippet:
```
NetSuite::ValidationError: TaxCode 'exp-tax-usa' is not valid for subsidiary US-SALES invoice_id=inv_09Bxyz
```

maria: Are customers charged incorrectly? Tax calculation on Stripe was fine, correct?

liz: Stripe charges are accurate; this is failing at import time because our transform forwards `tax_code` from the experiment metadata and NetSuite rejects unfamiliar codes. No customer-facing impact yet but invoices not posted.

raj: Hmm we've been accepting arbitrary tax_code fields from pricing experiments. New experiment added `exp-tax-usa` as a temporary tag. Our mapping table to NS tax codes is strict and missing the new tag.

ops-jen: @billing-bot please open a ticket for this and assign to eng + finance to decide mapping rules.

billing-bot: Created FIN-5063: "Tax code mapping: reject unknown experiment tags + audit blob" assigned to @raj, priority P2, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5063

maria: Proposed immediate mitigation: transform should map unknown tax_code -> default 'TAX-STD-US' and write the original tag to audit S3 so finance can review. Also a validation step in staging to catch unknown mappings before prod import. Approve?

raj: Agree. Plan: (1) implement mapping fallback in transform: if tag not in mapping table, set tax_code='TAX-STD-US' and append marker ` (orig_tax=exp-tax-usa, s3=audit/tax_tags/inv_09Bxyz.json)` (2) write full invoice metadata to s3://redwood-billing/audit/tax_tags/{invoice_id}.json with 45d lifecycle and finance+eng ACL (3) add a nightly validation job that reports any unknown tags to FIN-5063. ETA: 6 hours for patch + tests.

liz: Backfill: I've paused the NS import for today and moved staging CSVs to staging/quarantine/ until patch lands. 34 invoices blocked. Please ensure finance gets a CSV of blocked invoices for month-end.

maria: Need the CSV and the list of distinct unknown tags so tax/legal can sign off if any are new tax treatments.

raj: Will add `finance_tax_blocked_{date}.csv` to s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/ and attach to FIN-5063. Also will include a `unknown_tax_tags_{date}.csv` for review.

ops-jen: SRE note: we saw a small retry loop as the importer retried failures yesterday. I've disabled automatic retries for tax validation errors to avoid duplicate posting attempts.

billing-bot: FIN-5063 updated: comment by @raj with PR link https://git.redwood.ai/billing/commit/taxmap001 and validation job scheduled in staging.

liz: Once patch is in, please run the backfill in dry-run then apply. CC finance on FIN-5063.

raj: Will run dry-run now and post results. If green, merge+deploy in maintenance window tonight.

maria: Thanks. Keep finance looped. If any invoice hit month-end close, prioritize manual reconciliation. :thumbsup:
